name: What is the difference between framed and frameless cabinets?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between framed and frameless cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framed cabinets feature a solid wood frame attached to the front of the cabinet box, providing strength and a traditional appearance. Cabinet doors are attached to this frame, and there's often a small lip around the door opening. Frameless cabinets, also known as European-style, have no face frame; the doors attach directly to the cabinet box. This design offers a sleek, contemporary look and maximizes interior storage space as there is no frame to obstruct access. The choice often comes down to aesthetic preference and desired storage capacity.
acceptedAnswer.description: Framed cabinets have a face frame for traditional look and strength, while frameless cabinets offer a modern look and more interior storage by attaching doors directly to the box.
